newsitem.title: UK: C&W up on NTT alliance hopes.
newsitem.headline: C&W up on NTT alliance hopes.

text.p: Shares in Cable & Wireless Plc firmed in pre-market trade on Monday as report in the Sunday Telegraph said the company was in talks on an international alliance with NTT of Japan.
Separately the Sunday Times highlighted the stock as a "buy" on the back of hopes for an alliance with NTT.
C&W shares were quoted up 6p to 604 by 0733 GMT.
The Sunday Telegraph said NTT's international wing could merge with Japan's long-distance carrier International Digital Communications, where C&W has an 18 percent stake.
"A deal like that would certainly give Cable & Wireless one hell of a strong presence in Asia, said one dealer.
It added that C&W chief executive Richard Brown had been discussing an even closer link with NTT, involving either a joint company or mutual shareholdings.
No-one at C&W could immediately be reached for comment.
